uncertainties: paid-plan share of any users is unobservable
Store search ranking may hide better-performing validators not matching the query
buyer demand outside Apify (e.g. accounting import users) is not measured here
verdict_reason: At least a dozen directly competing CSV validator Actors already exist on Apify Store and none shows more than 1 user in 30 days or 2 users ever; a generic CSV checker has no observable buyer pull in this channel, and paid-user volume cannot be observed at all.
reframe_candidate_hypothesis: If the Actor is ever listed (zero marginal build cost once the founder credential exists), treat it as a free-tier funnel only; the stronger adjacent pattern is per-output-row transform/dedupe of scraped datasets, but that market already has 5+ priced incumbents and is NOT verified as an opening.
